stable.releaseNotes: Adds source-aware Data Needed requests with locally learned cadence and report locations, five prioritized actionable Home items, in-progress half-day SAPR pacing and closest-working-day year-over-year comparison, and 30-second alphabetical Store/advisor meeting cards that automatically recompose for 16:9 or 9:16. Includes protected local settings and updater-safe approved runtime files.

beta.releaseNotes: Upcoming Beta baseline after Stable 0.10.11. Carries forward the source-aware refresh intelligence, private learned cadence, five-item Home, half-day SAPR pacing and 16:9/9:16 Advisor Meeting cards for optional continued testing.
